notes.title: Announcement on Obtaining Songs in the Director Simulator Game
notes.content:
Announcement on Obtaining Songs in the Director Simulator Game
  
Dear player friends:

Hey there! Hello everyone! Since the release of 'Director Simulator', we have been extremely fortunate to receive enthusiastic support and love from numerous players. The participation and dedication of every player make our gaming world more diverse and colorful. Here, our entire development team would like to send a big and warm thank you hug to every member!

Do you know? The songs that everyone has been longing for, after our efforts, we can finally meet you all! (The songs include "Summer Album", "A Few Words", "Counting Sheep", etc.) However, in order to deliver this surprise to everyone more perfectly, we have decided to offer exclusive benefits to those who have joined the official group! As long as you join our official group, you can bring these songs home for free. You know, we have put a lot of effort into making these songs accessible to everyone. Now, we can finally share this achievement with everyone!

More importantly, here, you can chat about your gaming experience with other like-minded friends, and we will also hold official events in the group from time to time, allowing you to participate in the joyful feast of the game at the first time!!! So, what are you guys waiting for? Join our official group now!

Official QQ group number: [965986107]

Director Simulator Development Team

October 22, 2024
